deepDive.markdownContent:
## Graceful Degradation Tiers

This deep dive walks through when to apply **Graceful Degradation Tiers**, how it interacts with adjacent patterns, and which signals prove it is working in production.

### Operating checklist

- Define success metrics and failure budgets.
- Validate behavior under partial outages.
- Keep runbooks and diagrams current for on-call engineers.
